mn34:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vajjīsu viharati ukkacelāyaṃ gaṅgāya nadiyā tīre.
mn34:2.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave māgadhako gopālako duppaññajātiko vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye asamavekkhitvā gaṅgāya nadiyā orimaṃ tīraṃ asamavekkhitvā pārimaṃ tīraṃ atittheneva gāvo patāresi uttaraṃ tīraṃ suvidehānaṃ.
mn34:3.1: atha kho bhikkhave gāvo majjhe gaṅgāya nadiyā sote āmaṇḍaliyaṃ karitvā tattheva anayabyasanaṃ āpajjiṃsu.
mn34:3.3: tathā hi so bhikkhave māgadhako gopālako duppaññajātiko vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye asamavekkhitvā gaṅgāya nadiyā orimaṃ tīraṃ asamavekkhitvā pārimaṃ tīraṃ atittheneva gāvo patāresi uttaraṃ tīraṃ suvidehānaṃ.
mn34:3.4: evameva kho bhikkhave ye keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā akusalā imassa lokassa, akusalā parassa lokassa, akusalā māradheyyassa, akusalā amāradheyyassa, akusalā maccudheyyassa, akusalā amaccudheyyassa, tesaṃ ye sotabbaṃ saddahātabbaṃ maññissanti, tesaṃ taṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
mn34:4.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave māgadhako gopālako sappaññajātiko vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye samavekkhitvā gaṅgāya nadiyā orimaṃ tīraṃ samavekkhitvā pārimaṃ tīraṃ tittheneva gāvo patāresi uttaraṃ tīraṃ suvidehānaṃ.
mn34:5.1: so paṭhamaṃ patāresi ye te usabhā gopitaro gopariṇāyakā.
mn34:5.2: te tiriyaṃ gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamaṃsu.
mn34:5.4: tepi tiriyaṃ gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamaṃsu.
mn34:5.6: tepi tiriyaṃ gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamaṃsu.
mn34:5.8: tepi tiriyaṃ gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamaṃsu.
mn34:5.9: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave vacchako taruṇako tāvadeva jātako mātugoravakena vuyhamāno, sopi tiriyaṃ gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamāsi.
mn34:5.11: tathā hi so bhikkhave māgadhako gopālako sappaññajātiko vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye samavekkhitvā gaṅgāya nadiyā orimaṃ tīraṃ samavekkhitvā pārimaṃ tīraṃ tittheneva gāvo patāresi uttaraṃ tīraṃ suvidehānaṃ.
mn34:5.12: evameva kho bhikkhave ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kusalā imassa lokassa, kusalā parassa lokassa, kusalā māradheyyassa, kusalā amāradheyyassa, kusalā maccudheyyassa, kusalā amaccudheyyassa, tesaṃ ye sotabbaṃ saddahātabbaṃ maññissanti, tesaṃ taṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
mn34:6.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye te usabhā gopitaro gopariṇāyakā te tiriyaṃ gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamaṃsu,
mn34:6.2: evameva kho bhikkhave ye te bhikkhū arahanto khīṇāsavā vusitavanto katakaraṇīyā ohitabhārā anuppattasadatthā parikkhīṇabhavasaññojanā sammadaññāvimuttā, te tiriyaṃ mārassa sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gatā.
mn34:7.1: seyyathāpi te bhikkhave balavagāvo dammagāvo tiriyaṃ gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamaṃsu,
mn34:7.2: evameva kho bhikkhave ye te bhikkhū pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātikā tattha parinibbāyino anāvattidhammā tasmā lokā, tepi tiriyaṃ mārassa sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gamissanti.
mn34:8.1: seyyathāpi te bhikkhave vacchatarā vacchatariyo tiriyaṃ gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamaṃsu,
mn34:8.2: evameva kho bhikkhave ye te bhikkhū tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmino sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karissanti, tepi tiriyaṃ mārassa sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gamissanti.
mn34:9.1: seyyathāpi te bhikkhave vacchakā kisabalakā tiriyaṃ gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamaṃsu,
mn34:9.2: evameva kho bhikkhave ye te bhikkhū tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyanā, tepi tiriyaṃ mārassa sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gamissanti.
mn34:10.1: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave vacchako taruṇako tāvadeva jātako mātugoravakena vuyhamāno tiriyaṃ gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamāsi,
mn34:10.2: evameva kho bhikkhave ye te bhikkhū dhammānusārino saddhānusārino, tepi tiriyaṃ mārassa sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gamissanti.
mn34:11.1: ahaṃ kho pana bhikkhave kusalo imassa lokassa, kusalo parassa lokassa, kusalo māradheyyassa, kusalo amāradheyyassa, kusalo maccudheyyassa, kusalo amaccudheyyassa. tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave ye sotabbaṃ saddahātabbaṃ maññissanti, tesaṃ taṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
mn34:12.2: idaṃ vatvā sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā:
